items.q: Why did Jason quit DeepMind, and what pairing is the company?
items.a: Dream PM job translating AlphaGo-class research. DeFi summer felt more **open and fast**. Culture (TikTok/Netflix) is where time goes. **AI = infinite content. Chain = scarce rights.** Without the second, Midjourney deletes the illustrator bill.

items.q: What is an IP Lego, and who sets the money?
items.a: A character, world, or dataset is a **brick**. Maker sets cut / geo / commercial terms. Anyone can snap on a story or game **if they comply**. Graph + copyright enforce. Single artist can license without a studio legal team.

items.q: What is the attention monetization dilemma?
items.a: Internet **copies**; media **restricts**. Games picked spread: free-to-play + skins. Film: games and music both ~$25B early; games ~$180B, music still ~$25B. Story exports that toolkit past studios.
Checkout hides banking. Story should hide **chain and law**. If a creator or Web2 dev has to learn either, the product failed.

items.q: Who did SY pick, and what is the GTM?
items.a: Media operator (Byline → Radish → ~$0.5B Kakao) × research translator who writes the white paper. GTM: **incubate builders** (Kaiser office key, a16z intro), not hunt creators. Offense: everyone is now a studio.
